events.title: Microsoft Access 1.0 released
events.summary: Microsoft released Access 1.0 on November 16, 1992 — a desktop database with forms, queries, and the Jet engine for Windows.
events.about: Access put relational databases on millions of office PCs — power users built line-of-business apps without a DBA. Its file format and VBA macros influenced how small teams shipped internal tools before web apps and SaaS took over.

narrative.whyChosen: Access democratized relational databases on Windows desktops.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved non-programmers could build data-driven applications with GUIs.
narrative.problemSolved: Departments needed databases but could not afford server DBAs and custom development.
